description: Capability scoped to output-* windows. Narrowed for defence in depth: if an output is compromised (an XSS via a malicious dataset URL, a shader bug, a webview vulnerability) the blast radius is network fetch plus the window controls it drives on itself. No core:default, so no Tauri command invoke at all; no filesystem, no keychain, no asset protocol, no shell, no dialog, no clipboard, no updater, no window creation, no localhost HTTP. This does NOT restrain the manager: Tauri checks window commands against the CALLING window, so the manager's grants live in default.json.
